## Code Generation Guideline
## IMPORTANT: Read the `/docs` directory first

**ALL code generated by Claude Code MUST ALWAYS first refer to the relevant documentation file(s) in the `/docs` directory.** Before writing or changing any code, check `/docs` for the file(s) covering the area you are working on and follow the standards they define. Do not generate code until you have read them.

- `docs/ui.md` — UI coding standards (shadcn/ui components only, no custom components; date formatting with date-fns). Read this before writing any UI code.

When adding a new file to `/docs`, list it here so it is discoverable.

## Project state

Next.js 16.3.5 / React 19.2.8 app (a lifting diary), currently on the `dashboard` branch (`main` is the main branch). Built so far:

- Clerk authentication (`src/proxy.ts`, sign-in and sign-up pages under `src/app/`).
- Drizzle ORM + Neon Postgres: schema in `src/db/schema.ts` (exercises, workouts, workout exercises, sets), relations in `src/db/relations.ts`, client in `src/db/index.ts`, config in `drizzle.config.ts`, and a `getWorkoutsForDate` query in `src/data/workouts.ts` (not yet used by any page).
- shadcn/ui set up (`components.json`); installed components in `src/components/ui/`: button, calendar, card, input, label, popover.
- `/dashboard` (`src/app/dashboard/page.tsx`): UI-only client page with a date picker (defaults to today) and a list of workouts using placeholder data. Data fetching is not wired up yet.
- Environment variables live in `.env` (not `.env.local`); don't commit or echo its contents.

## Commands

- `npm run dev` — start the dev server (http://localhost:3000)
- `npm run build` — production build
- `npm run start` — run the production build
- `npm run lint` — ESLint (flat config in `eslint.config.mjs`, extends `eslint-config-next`)

There is no test runner configured yet.

## Architecture

- App Router (`src/app`), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 (via `@tailwindcss/postcss`, no `tailwind.config` file — v4 uses CSS-based config in `globals.css`).
- Path alias `@/*` maps to `src/*` (see `tsconfig.json`).
- **Before writing any code**, read the relevant guide under `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` — this project pins a Next.js version with breaking changes relative to older/training-data Next.js conventions (see `AGENTS.md`). Check for deprecation notices before using patterns you already know. The docs are split into `01-app` (App Router — the one this project uses), `02-pages`, `03-architecture`, and `04-community`; start in `01-app`.
- `.env.local` exists locally for environment variables; don't commit or echo its contents.
